map.不会。DPI 只影响 PNG 的 pHYs 打印密度元数据，不会增加图像细节；例: No. DPI only changes the PNG pHYs print-density metadata; it does not add image detail. For example, 295 px is about 25 mm at 300 DPI and about 50 mm at 150 DPI, so resample the pixels if you need the nominal print size.
